changelog:
- Initial release: Enables scraping Instagram posts tagged at a specific location.
- Supports searching for locations by name and retrieving posts using cursor-based pagination.
- Returns media items with captions, like/comment counts, media URLs, and user info.
- Requires user to be logged into Instagram; browser must be open on an Instagram page.
- Includes guidance for pre-execution checks, capability invocation, and error handling.
- Details best practices for batch processing and notes for resuming interrupted sessions.
